method.signal: Positions C, LW, RW, D ranked by the defending team's last-10 goals allowed to each position (descending; ties keep C, LW, RW, D order). WATCH is the top position.
method.grading: Hit when the offense team scored at least one goal by a skater listed at the watched position (NHL stats API skater summary). Empty-net goals count; shootout goals do not.
method.games: Regular season and playoffs only. Picks are logged before puck drop and never changed afterwards.
